answer: Think of a falcon circling a landfill: it only lands where the ground is real. Waste managers prove the same way, with a certification managers renew after facility inspections, stamped by an inspector who walked the terrace of the plant and checked the timber piled for sorting. No certificate, no account. A sybil farm would have to pass a fresh inspection for every fake name, booking real visits, paying real inspectors, waiting weeks for each. One honest manager renews once a year; a hundred fakes need a hundred inspections, and the bill for those visits is larger than a whole epoch pays.
